data.narrative:
Innoviz Technologies (INVZ) is a public-stage autonomous systems company operating in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The valuation universe comprises five private peers—Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air—with no directly comparable public comps available in the narrow sector.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to this analysis. The Drones & Autonomous sector contains only five companies total; filtering by stage alignment, adjacency, or valuation tier yields fewer than three datapoints in any subcategory, falling below the minimum threshold required for robust median-based triangulation. A fallback to all-sector median would conflate companies with materially different business models, growth profiles, and capital intensity, introducing unacceptable error.

Given the constraint on peer-based methods, this analysis cannot support a quantified valuation range based solely on the provided data. A credible triangulation would require either: (1) expanding the peer set through secondary research on additional autonomous/robotics companies at comparable stages; (2) applying revenue or EBITDA multiple analysis if Innoviz's financials were available; or (3) DCF methodology with disclosed guidance. The key uncertainty remains the absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables. Further data collection is necessary before a sober point estimate or range can be defended.
